a: The [On Deletion] effect gained from this card can only play a card whose name is [Beelzemon].
Card Q&A.q: Can the [On Deletion] effect gained from this card play [Beelzemon: Blast Mode] from my trash?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Trash the top 3 cards of your deck.[When Digivolving] This Digimon gains "[On Deletion] If there are 10 or more cards in your trash, you may play 1 [Beelzemon] from your trash without paying the cost" until the end of your opponent's turn.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Wizard] or [Demon Lord] in its traits, it gets +2000 DP.
